Assam CM Himanta Sarma mourns loss of lives in Kaziranga accident; directs immediate relief measures
Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma expressed grief over the Kaziranga accident, extended condolences to the families of victims and assured the injured of the best medical care. Minister Atul Bora is overseeing rescue and relief arrangements at the site.
Vehicle collision in Assam’s Kaziranga leaves multiple casualties. (Image via PTI)
New Delhi: Chief Minister Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma has expressed profound grief over the tragic accident in Kaziranga earlier today and conveyed his heartfelt condolences to the families who have lost their loved ones.
Terming the incident as deeply distressing, the Chief Minister said that the loss of lives has shaken everyone and that his thoughts and prayers are with the bereaved families. He said that while no words can lessen their pain, the Government and the people of Assam stand firmly with them in this hour of grief.
The Chief Minister, who is currently on a two-day official tour of Biswanath district, is closely monitoring the situation and coordinating with the Golaghat District Commissioner and Minister for Panchayat and Rural Development Shri Atul Bora. Shri Bora is present at the accident site and personally overseeing the ongoing relief and rescue operations. Dr. Sarma has also directed Education Minister Dr. Ranoj Pegu to proceed to the site immediately and extend all possible assistance.
Today’s incident in Kaziranga is unfortunate and deeply painstaking.
I will visit the accident site tomorrow to assess the situation and review the treatment being meted to the affected. https://t.co/n8wwDUI8ih
— Himanta Biswa Sarma (@himantabiswa) November 13, 2026
The Chief Minister has directed the concerned authorities to ensure that the injured receive immediate and the best possible medical attention. He has also called for all necessary arrangements to be made in connection with the accident.
Dr. Sarma has prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured and strength and courage for the bereaved families to bear this irreparable loss. The Chief Minister will visit Golaghat district tomorrow to take stock of the situation.
